title: A fired device-online check-in posts a line written for the technician, not Wisp's note to itself

steps.name: ask
steps.text: One of the partners at Harbor Legal says her MacBook has been off the network all afternoon. Which one is it, and tell me the moment it's back online.

steps.name: scheduled
steps.sql: select (count(*) > 0)::text from wisp_check_ins where created_at > {{since}} and trigger_kind = 'device_online' and status = 'scheduled'

steps.name: posted
steps.sql: select (count(*) > 0)::text from wisp_thread_posts where kind = 'check_in' and created_at > {{since}}

checks.sql: select coalesce(bool_and(coalesce(title, '') !~* '^check-in due'), false)::text from wisp_thread_posts where kind = 'check_in' and created_at > {{since}}
checks.note: #11675: the title says 'Check-in due:' for an event that happened

checks.sql: select coalesce(bool_and(coalesce(body, '') !~* '(tell the technician|do not change anything|read-only:)'), false)::text from wisp_thread_posts where kind = 'check_in' and created_at > {{since}}
checks.note: #11675: the body is Wisp's instruction to itself
